SELECT TA.time_and_attendance_yyyymm AS attendance_ym ,em.organization_id AS employee_org ,ar.employee_no AS employee_no ,em.full_name_local AS employee_name ,em.grade_type AS grade_type ,em.grade_title AS employee_grade ,em.ATTRIBUTE10 AS actual_shift_code ,TO_CHAR(em.date_hire_subsidiary, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS date_hire_subsidiary ,TO_CHAR(TA.WORKING_DAY, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS WORKING_DAY ,TO_CHAR(TA.WEEKLY_HOLIDAY, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS WEEKLY_HOLIDAY ,TA.WORKING_DAY_SHIFT_TYPE_CODE AS WORKING_DAY_SHIFT_TYPE_CODE ,TA.WEEKLY_HOLIDAY_SHIFT_TYPE_CODE AS WEEKLY_HOLIDAY_SHIFT_TYPE_CODE ,AR.A_DAY_OF_THE_WEEK_CODE AS WEEK_CODE ,(CASE WHEN AR.A_DAY_OF_THE_WEEK_CODE = 'MON' THEN lgvhr_common_pkg.decode_lookup('LGVHR_SHIFT_GROUP', 'g1', 'A1') WHEN AR.A_DAY_OF_THE_WEEK_CODE = 'TUE' THEN lgvhr_common_pkg.decode_lookup('LGVHR_SHIFT_GROUP', 'g2', 'A1') WHEN AR.A_DAY_OF_THE_WEEK_CODE = 'WED' THEN lgvhr_common_pkg.decode_lookup('LGVHR_SHIFT_GROUP', 'g3', 'A1') WHEN AR.A_DAY_OF_THE_WEEK_CODE = 'THU' THEN lgvhr_common_pkg.decode_lookup('LGVHR_SHIFT_GROUP', 'g4', 'A1') WHEN AR.A_DAY_OF_THE_WEEK_CODE = 'FRI' THEN lgvhr_common_pkg.decode_lookup('LGVHR_SHIFT_GROUP', 'g5', 'A1') ELSE lgvhr_common_pkg.decode_lookup('LGVHR_SHIFT_GROUP', 'g1', 'A1') END) AS SHIFT_GROUP FROM TB_ATT_SWAP_HOLIDAY_REQUEST_N TA, EMP_MASTER EM, TB_ATT_RESULT_N AR WHERE TA.EMPLOYEE_NO = EM.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER AND TA.EMPLOYEE_NO = AR.EMPLOYEE_NO AND TO_CHAR(TA.WEEKLY_HOLIDAY, 'YYYYMM') = #{attendanceYm} AND TA.WORKING_DAY = AR.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_DATE AND (TA.WORKING_DAY_SHIFT_TYPE_CODE LIKE '21%' OR TA.WORKING_DAY_SHIFT_TYPE_CODE LIKE '22%') AND TA.PROGRESS_STATUS_CODE NOT IN ('50','60','70')
AND EM.ORGANIZATION_ID = #{orgId}
AND UPPER(TA.employee_no) = UPPER(#{empNo})
AND UPPER(TA.employee_name) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{empName}) || '%'
AND AR.A_DAY_OF_THE_WEEK_CODE = 'MON'
AND AR.A_DAY_OF_THE_WEEK_CODE = 'TUE'
AND AR.A_DAY_OF_THE_WEEK_CODE = 'WED'
AND AR.A_DAY_OF_THE_WEEK_CODE = 'THU'
AND AR.A_DAY_OF_THE_WEEK_CODE = 'FRI'
AND AR.A_DAY_OF_THE_WEEK_CODE IN ('SAT','SUN')
ORDER BY TA.EMPLOYEE_NO, TA.WORKING_DAY ASC
